_comment: Semi-automatic model/executor selection for the coding lifecycle. Operator-maintained until the live availability prober (Todo 1916) writes this file on a schedule; the prober will emit the same shape. tgw.model_selector.select_executor() consumes only 'executors' and 'roles.<role>.prefer' (today: roles 'implementation' and 'review'). The per-role 'model' hints and the 'role_chart' block are carried for humans and the future prober / model-aware executor. Edit /opt/TGW/tgw-lib/config/model-availability.json to change it live; this repo copy is the committed default.
cost_policy: Preserve the operator Claude subscription (the valuable resource) for judgement roles; route bulk / mechanical / draft work to the free opencode-zen DeepSeek and Groq keys via the opencode executor once its backend is wired (coding-workflow plan item).

claude.note: operator Claude subscription — reserve for orchestration, semantic review, high-risk gates, and complex implementation

opencode.reason: executor backend not wired — needs _execute_opencode() in codex_implement.py + the review worker, an opencode prompt-translator profile, and the opencode user's opencode.jsonc model config. Coding-workflow plan item.
opencode.note: free DeepSeek V4 Flash (opencode-zen key) + Groq key — use for evidence, mechanical verification, doc/test drafting, and low-risk bulk implementation

codex.reason: 20x Pro subscription lapsed 2026-08-29 — usage limit until reset

manual.harness: a supervising tgw-coders session services a filesystem task card; always available, last resort

deepseek.reason: no standalone coding backend; DeepSeek models are reached through the opencode executor (opencode-zen)

implementation.research: role 4 (implementation actor): best Sol xhigh / least DeepSeek V4 Pro / other Sonnet 5, DeepSeek V4 Flash for low-risk edits
implementation.note: opencode-first is intentional cost control; it falls through to claude while opencode is unavailable. Revisit once risk-tiering exists so complex work escalates to claude automatically.

review.research: role 6 (semantic reviewer): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5
review.note: semantic judgement stays on claude; escalate to claude-opus-5 for lifecycle/authority/rollback changes once the selector takes a risk input

orchestrator.research: role 1 (plan authority / orchestrator): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5

contract_compiler.research: role 2 (contract compiler): best Sol xhigh / least Sonnet 5

evidence_worker.research: role 3 (evidence / reconnaissance): best DeepSeek V4 Pro / least DeepSeek V4 Flash

mechanical_verifier.research: role 5 (mechanical verifier): best DeepSeek V4 Flash / least GPT Luna — cheap, no semantic judgement

high_risk_gate.research: role 7 (activation / rebinding / rollback gate): never below Opus 5 + a distinct second model

doctor_planner.research: role 8 (doctor / repair planner): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5 — escalate to opus-5 for lifecycle or production-boundary repairs

operator_assistant.research: role 9 (operator assistant / receipt navigator): best Sonnet 5 / least DeepSeek V4 Flash

doc_test_drafting.research: role 10 (documentation / test-plan drafting): best Sonnet 5 / least DeepSeek V4 Flash — normative runbooks/contracts stay on claude
